tools.name: orivale_dual_rail_catalog
tools.description: Return the complete catalog of Orivale x402 Base/Solana USDC APIs and 8 Apify Store Pay-Per-Event cloud scrapers. Call first for capability/price discovery; do not call to scrape a URL.

tools.name: orivale_bounties_radar
tools.description: Scan live zero-KYC crypto, code & agent bounties with fake-escrow honeypot blocking and EV scoring. Free top-3 preview; pass x402_payment ($0.005 USDC) for full feed.

tools.name: orivale_clean_markdown
tools.description: Extract clean RAG-ready Markdown, title & pricing entities from a public https:// web page (use orivale_youtube_transcript_hooks for video URLs).

tools.name: orivale_b2b_domain_enrich
tools.description: Enrich a B2B company domain with hiring/API buying signals, ICP fit score (0-100), and 2-line cold-outreach icebreaker (use orivale_tech_stack_signal for 30+ framework/pixel detection).

tools.name: orivale_tech_stack_signal
tools.description: Fingerprint 30+ B2B website technologies across Frontend, CDN, Pixels, CRM, Payments, Auth & Security Headers (use orivale_b2b_domain_enrich for ICP outreach copy).

tools.name: orivale_youtube_transcript_hooks
tools.description: Extract video title, channel, timestamped chapters, transcript excerpt, and 3 viral hook angles from a public https:// YouTube/video URL.

tools.name: orivale_shopify_competitor
tools.description: Analyze a Shopify or DTC e-commerce storefront domain's live SKU pricing distribution, markdown share, and 3 ad counter-angles.

tools.name: orivale_base_contract_audit
tools.description: Audit any Base Mainnet (eip155:8453) smart contract or relayer wallet for deployed bytecode, nonce liveness, and Base USDC balance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: orivale_dual_rail_catalog · Private data: orivale_base_contract_audit · Public sink: orivale_shopify_competitor.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: orivale_dual_rail_catalog · Private data: orivale_base_contract_audit · Public sink: orivale_shopify_competitor

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
